verdict.rationale: Asana documents AI Teammates with shared memory and Work Graph context that carries forward across work. It also documents an official MCP server that brings the work graph into external AI assistants such as Claude, so other tools and agents can read and act on the same task context. However, there is no documented explicit agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff mechanism that guarantees context is preserved, and the shared-memory claims come from marketing pages only. Missing for 10: documented handoff protocol between agents/tools, explicit guarantees of context/information preservation on transfer, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information

citations.quote: Pre-built AI agents that work alongside your team inside real workflows, with shared memory, governance, and context from the Work Graph
Every completed task, every piece of feedback, every preference gets carried forward, so no one repeats context they've already given
The Asana app in Claude brings your work graph directly into Claude conversations, allowing you to turn AI-powered discussions into actionable work without leaving Claude.
Connect Asana to your favorite AI assistants, automation tools, and enterprise platforms
